scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=server && npm run test:coverage --workspace=client
